description: Graviti (formerly Cairn; renamed 2026-08) integrity ledger — append-only, hash-chained version history of the index. Entries before v7 reference the Cairn name and are preserved verbatim: same Ed25519 signing key, same chain. Each entry commits to the canonical index content hash and the previous entry's hash; entries are Ed25519-signed and anchored to Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps. Rewriting any historical entry breaks every hash after it.
canonicalization: JSON with recursively sorted keys and no whitespace (reproduce with: jq -cjS)
index_hash_covers: the object {accountability_log, categories} as served inside /index.json
entry_hash_covers: all entry fields except entry_hash, signature, signing_key, and anchor
signature_scheme: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of entry_hash; public key at /public-key.pem
files_manifest: From v25 each entry's signed core carries files.artifacts: sha256 of every published data artifact, hashed per files.note — client-side transport-integrity verification against this manifest reaches the edge of the consumer's process; entries before v25 predate it and verify unchanged.

files.note: sha256 of every published data artifact, pinned inside this signed entry so transport-layer tampering between origin and client is detectable. JSON artifacts: hash of the canonical JSON (recursively sorted keys, no whitespace) after deleting the volatile top-level fields generated_at and integrity (build timestamp, and this entry's own hash — self-referential by construction; both absent in per-category files, where the delete is a no-op). Reproduce: curl -s <url> | jq -cjS 'del(.generated_at, .integrity)' | sha256sum. /llms.txt: hash of the exact served bytes. Tokened client-report payloads are deliberately unlisted — their URLs are private to their recipients. Scripted verification: verify-payload.mjs at https://github.com/sclaytonmyosin/graviti-engine.

not_pinned./pulse.json: operational telemetry regenerated every build from live logs and build time — pinning it would force a ledger entry per rebuild or false tamper alarms; it is not part of the verified record
not_pinned./receipts.json: on-chain receipt cache re-verified against public explorers at every build; independently checkable by replaying the OTS proofs it cites
not_pinned./ledger.json: self-referential — verified by hash chain and signatures, stronger than a pinned hash
not_pinned./public-key.pem: a key pinned by a signature made with that key proves nothing; pin it out-of-band (committed in the public mirror repo)
not_pinned./version.json: per-build deploy-skew probe, unique by design
